items.title: Kasoor
items.creator: Prateek Kuhad
items.why: Vulnerable acoustic indie that captures the sweet, fragile anxiety of falling in love across distances.

items.title: Roz Roz
items.creator: The Yellow Diary, Shilpa Rao
items.why: A lush indie-pop duet detailing the quiet distance and unsaid feelings creeping into modern love.

items.title: Faasle
items.creator: Kaavish
items.why: Gentle, semi-classical Pakistani indie exploring emotional separation with breathtaking, soothing vocal elegance.

items.title: Mystery of Love
items.creator: Sufjan Stevens
items.why: Tender fingerpicked guitar and whispery vocals create a blissful, fleeting sanctuary for romantic dreamers.

items.title: Choo Lo
items.creator: The Local Train
items.why: Soaring guitar lines and heart-wrenching vocals build an unforgettable anthem about letdown and lingering longing.

items.title: Rivers and Roads
items.creator: The Head and the Heart
items.why: A swell of acoustic harmonies capturing the ache of moving away from those you love most.

items.title: The Thing
items.creator: John Carpenter
items.why: Paranoia and masterclass practical effects fuse in this icy, claustrophobic tale of an assimilating alien organism.

items.title: Hereditary
items.creator: Ari Aster
items.why: A harrowing portrait of grief decaying into demonic terror that will linger long after the credits roll.

items.title: Alien
items.creator: Ridley Scott
items.why: A masterclass in quiet tension where cosmic isolation meets terrifying, biomechanical nightmare design.

items.title: The Shining
items.creator: Stanley Kubrick
items.why: Isolation turns a snowy mountain hotel into a sprawling, hypnotic labyrinth of maddening psychological decay.

items.title: Get Out
items.creator: Jordan Peele
items.why: A razor-sharp social satire wrapped in an unsettling, deeply paranoid horror thriller about insidious control.

items.title: The Wicker Man
items.creator: Robin Hardy
items.why: Sunlit island paganism and eerie musicality build toward one of cinema's most unforgettable, shocking climaxes.
